data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for managing Android apps: launching, backing up, restoring, uninstalling, and sharing.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to inspect installed Android apps, launch them, create and restore APK backups, uninstall packages, and share them via Bluetooth or link.
use_when: You need to build a custom application manager or app launcher for Android.
Your app needs to create and restore APK backups on the device.
avoid_when: You are targeting iOS or desktop platforms (Android only).
You only need to launch URLs or share generic text/files without Android package management.
strengths: Comprehensive feature set for Android package management (launching, backing up, uninstalling, sharing).
Simple imperative API using classes like ApkScouter, ApkController, and ApkBackup.
weaknesses: Requires manual permission handling for external storage backups.
data.setup_notes: May require storage permissions (WRITE_EXTERNAL_PERMISSION) for APK backups on Android.
data.minimal_example:
ApkScouter apkScouter = ApkScouter();
List<App> apps = await apkScouter.getInstalledApps();
